scope: Local integer arithmetic and rank bounds for fixed synthetic job keys. No GPU timing, new official proof check, network acceptance or profit measurement.
construction: B=0. Four distinct A commitments per shape and job key: zero A, then a single +1 at flat positions 0,1,2. Raw AB=0 throughout. Bound V3 seeds are regenerated.
factorization: For each chunk, T=P_chunk Q_chunk. Unit pivots (+/-1), selected by Markowitz fill cost, give an exact integer T=X Y. Reject updates with entries above the selected cap, and represent any remaining matrix by its nonzero columns or rows. Try caps 2,3,4,8,16,32,64,127 until padded width matches a proven rank lower bound.
update_cap_scope: The cap bounds the updated work matrix; original core entries and fallback factors can already have larger values. Actual retained factor coefficients are checked and recorded separately.
rank_proof: 65521 is checked prime. A nonzero minor modulo this prime is a nonzero integer minor, so modular rank lower-bounds rational rank. Exact integer T=X Y upper-bounds rank by factor width. All 512 chunks have equal 16-wide padded lower and upper bounds; exact unpadded rank is not claimed where these differ.
rank_scope: These bounds apply to exact linear core factorizations for these inputs with a single contracted dense product and 16-wide steps. They do not bound arbitrary algorithms or direct XOR-state computation. Full-rank sampled minors of U,V also preserve each noise-only core rank in its output product.
arithmetic_count_scope: Padded widths count dense inner work only. Transform nonzero-term counts include +/-1 terms that can be additions. They exclude full setup, data movement, raw-input corrections, INT8 residual corrections, proof and final-hash costs.
fresh_candidate_cost: P depends on fresh A commitment, so the core factorization changes for every fresh A. B and its seed may be reused, but the complete both-sided plan is not reused across those four A candidates.

screen.scope: Exact local integer factorization and arithmetic screening. No GPU benchmark or new official/network proof acceptance.

exact_checks.scope: Independent local direct-prefix and hash checks. Not a new official verifier or network check.
